scope: Actual upstream factory class invoked with supplied descriptor; SDK and VS Code host services are stubs. This is not an extension-host, VSIX, or DAP integration test.
implication: When VS Code supplies a package.json executable descriptor, current factory skips fallback vsdbg path and SDK-derived DOTNET_ROOT injection.
requirement: Static executable path, matching debugger package, existing .debugger installation, and suitable inherited runtime environment.
